summary_1line: Bhishma recounts a rishi advising King Vasuman that righteousness, self-restraint, right giving, and steadfast virtue bring welfare in this world and the next.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a lonely forest, King Vasuman bows before a serene Bhrigu sage seated calmly beneath the trees.
A man reaching eagerly for dripping honey above a cliff while the abyss below symbolizes the unseen fall of desire.
The king sits attentively before the ascetic as the sage speaks of righteousness and the path beyond desire.
